bullets.text: IT Teams Need Proactivity - Internal IT should shift from reactive problem-solving to proactive strategic growth initiatives.
Digital Transformation Is Essential - Businesses must embrace digitalisation to remain competitive in today's fast-paced market.

Nexus International's Unique Strategy - The company thrives in underserved markets, achieving $546M revenue without external funding.
NinjaOne Expands MSP Partnerships - New Head of MSP Partnerships aims to enhance growth and efficiency for partners.

Apple's Legal Battles Over Patents - Ongoing disputes in the UK and US highlight the complexities of mobile device licensing.
